brief.p: Typical views per video in the last 12 months against the year before: story channels 0.8× (4 of 9 up), technical channels 0.9× (6 of 15 up) and personality channels 1.1× (3 of 5 up). Personality channels are holding up best. (Older videos have had longer to collect views, so a ratio near 1× means a channel kept its audience.)
Growing: Boxing Mania (45K → 287K), Fight Story (78K → 281K) and Teep Muay Thai (5K → 9K). Shrinking: Kombat Capital (126K → 9K), Pro Striking (67K → 22K) and Sean "Muay Thai Guy" Fagan (22K → 7K).

The 12 growing channels make mostly technical breakdowns (25%) and fighter profiles (17%); the 14 shrinking ones lean on technical breakdowns (31%) and fighter profiles (17%). Inside channels that mix formats, below their own usual: fighter profiles (0.87×) and news and talk (0.95×). Creators are making less news and talk (14% → 10%).
On story channels, 10–20 min fall short (0.77×). Videos of 20+ minutes are 30% of uploads now, against 25% 3-4 years ago.
Titles that name a fighter do better (1.09× against 0.91×), titles that are about a woman fighter do better (2.47× against 0.97×) and titles that have a word in CAPS do better (1.02× against 0.97×).

Biggest jumps over a channel's usual in the last 4 months: "Gervonta Davis vs Mario Barrios Was BRUTAL 😳" (Die Hard Fighting, 2.5M, 208×), "Most Brutal MMA Fights of 2026 😳" (Die Hard Fighting, 3M, 171×) and "Alycia Baumgardner vs Bo Mi Re Shin Was BRUTAL 😳" (Die Hard Fighting, 1.7M, 126×).

Other creators' videos about these fighters are beating their channel's usual: Mona Kimura (9 videos, 20×), Smilla Sundell (3 videos, 15×), Adrien Broner (4 videos, 8.0×) and Abdulla Dayakaev (3 videos, 6.6×).

Your last 10 uploads: median 34K views, typical length 11 min, 9 of 10 named a fighter in the title. Best: "Dagestan's Bruce Lee — The Perfect Fighter | Asadula Imangazaliev" (600K, 23× your usual). Your latest upload is 5 days old.

headline: Technical channels are keeping their views better than story ones (0.9× against 0.8×); the growing channels mostly make technical breakdowns; titles that are about a woman fighter do 2.47× their channel's usual.
